document.about: WTO Trade Profiles 2023: two template pages per economy. The first sets the band MERCHANDISE TRADE under the economy's key figures; the second ends with an INDUSTRIAL PROPERTY table whose heads, Residents and Non-residents, stand over each economy's counts.

notes: 2026-11-26 (#420): both repeat at one place on every economy's page, and were removed as running heads and feet: no copy of MERCHANDISE TRADE (197 in the PDF) or of Residents (591) was kept.

checks.issue: #420: the band MERCHANDISE TRADE, under each economy's key figures, was read as a running head.
#420: the heads over each economy's patent counts were read as a running foot.
